content:
Metrics for Cloud NAT are batched and exported to Monitoring every one minute. Monitoring
data is retained for six weeks.
By default, the dashboard provides data analysis for the past hour (1h). You can request
analysis for a different time interval either by selecting one of the preconfigured intervals from
the menu or by manually entering the time interval you want. For example: 3h (for 3 hours) or
4d (for 4 days) or 6w (for six weeks).
